items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I can remember Don Albert's orchestra.

ctx.x: What other bands came through there that you got to see, that you can remember?

Well, I can remember -- I can remember Don Albert's orchestra. I can remember -- I don't remember Alphonso Trent's orchestra, because I think Trent's orchestra was a little before this time, a little before my time. I can't remember that orchestra too well, but I do know that Alphonso Trent had a marvelous orchestra. And some other bands used to come through from like Alexandria, Louisiana. We had Crome, Taft Crome, who was very well known in that area. And we had bands that used to come from, oh, come from…

really gone on to big times that were from Houston, Texas. One of them was -- what did they call -- used to play with -- a saxophone player, used to play and sing. Sort of a -- he's just terrific. He's still around. I can't think of his name, but it'll come back to me. But he was from Houston.
